feedback: The ~668 people above floors 5-25 is not in the building data, and neither is the wind. Delete both, or mark them as unverified. A crew could stage or search based on made-up numbers.

The caller said people may still be up there, and the message doesn't say so. Add it, along with the black smoke visible from the 4th-floor windows. The freight elevator is on record and you left it out. Add it to the stairs and access line.

Put the caller's report first, then the building facts. Trim the wind and the build year and 'steel frame'. The playbook asks for stairs, standpipes, sprinklers, hydrants, staging and roof, so give those facts priority. Staging and roof are missing.
